, CASE WHEN pc.id IS NULL THEN c.name ELSE CONCAT(pc.name, '：', c.name) END AS category, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book_copy bc WHERE bc.book_id = b.id AND bc.status != 'DISCARDED') AS total_copies, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book_copy bc WHERE bc.book_id = b.id AND bc.status = 'AVAILABLE') AS available_copies, CASE WHEN b.cover_object_key IS NULL OR b.cover_object_key = '' THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT('/books/', b.id, '/cover/content') END AS cover_url
mapper.select: SELECT FROM book b WHERE b.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM book b JOIN book_category c ON c.id = b.category_id LEFT JOIN book_category pc ON pc.id = c.parent_id WHERE b.id = #{id}

mapper.update: UPDATE book category_id=#{request.categoryId}, title=#{request.title}, subtitle=#{request.subtitle}, author=#{request.author}, isbn=#{request.isbn}, publisher=#{request.publisher}, published_date=#{request.publishedDate}, edition=#{request.edition}, language=#{request.language}, description=#{request.description}, cover_object_key=#{request.coverObjectKey}, status=#{request.status}, version=version+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{request.expectedVersion}
